title: Genus-3 Faltings-Hriljac heights
objective: Implement a bounded reference Faltings-Hriljac height and regulator engine for odd-degree genus-3 hyperelliptic Jacobians with explicit local capability diagnostics

oracles: exact finite intersection and graph-lattice self checks

handoff.summary: Implemented a bounded ordinary-Python genus-3 Faltings--Hriljac reference engine: exact regular-model matrix validation and Cox--Zucker vertical solves; replay-certified good and irreducible-nodal finite paths; exact rational-section intersections; split-Mumford factorization and Holmes moving representatives; complete finite candidate-prime plans with structured unsupported records; Muller theta Green functions with refinement witnesses; the frozen periods/Abel--Jacobi adapter; global pairing, canonical-height, pairing-matrix, and regulator assembly. Raw model-basis Abel--Jacobi integrals are explicitly normalized as z=A^-1*w before use with tau=A^-1*B, with raw and normalized coordinates retained in the certificate. Complete finite plans and automatic archimedean witnesses are bound to exact curve, Mumford divisor, moving representative, theta support, and class-multiple keys; cross-move reuse is rejected. Supplied matrices, local symbols, component assertions, prime-set assertions, and rigorous analytic assertions remain conditional and cannot promote certification. The automatic theta envelope is odd-degree genus-3 QQ, rational infinity, split rational Mumford degree three. The focused runtime, including a real period/Abel--Jacobi/theta integration regression, passed against frozen periods commit 717df283.
risks: The current local-reduction cluster certificates do not encode replayable full regular-model incidence/blow-up matrices or section-to-component maps. Reducible semistable fibres therefore remain unsupported for certified automatic heights; supplied matrices/component claims are recorded only as conditional inputs.
The archimedean result is numerical and non-rigorous: theta radius refinement is checked, but period, Abel--Jacobi, truncation, and rounding errors are not enclosed.

Automatic archimedean integration depends on bsd-periods. It passed the full internal runtime against frozen periods commit 717df283, but no independent Magma end-to-end numeric height oracle is claimed.

Bad reduction at p=2 and rational sections meeting singular plane-fibre points require supplied certified local pairings. Mature integer factorization is guarded by an input-size cap, not a wall-clock cancellation mechanism.
Broad native, SEA, and Wasm suites were intentionally deferred to centralized integration at the integration owner's request.
next_steps: Merge bsd-periods first, then compare one automatic split degree-three odd-model example with Magma CanonicalHeight and check two independent moving fibres.
Expose the selected classes/functions through the centrally owned hyperelliptic public API and attach the finite/archimedean provenance to the BSD quotient result.

Extend typed local certificates with curve-bound, replayable regular-model intersection matrices and section component maps for reducible split-cluster fibres, then widen the theta move for Mumford degree one and two.
Replace numerical theta refinement by ball-enclosed periods, Abel--Jacobi integrals, theta tails, and determinant/regulator arithmetic when a rigorous analytic backend is available.
